tags.description: A deep red pouch, heavier than the others, printed with a cartoon bone giving a thumbs up. RICH MARROW — NOW WITH MORE OF WHAT YOU'RE MADE OF! The straw on this one is wider.
tags.use_message: Thicker than the rest, and warm in a way the others aren't, like it kept its own heat all the way from wherever it was made. It coats your teeth. It is genuinely, aggressively nourishing. You feel better almost immediately and you would rather you didn't.
